lead: Tejashwi Yadav is best known as an Indian cricketer, born on 9 November 1988 in Patna.
As of 2026, he is 37 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has represented Delhi Capitals and Jharkhand cricket team and has held the office of Member of the Bihar Legislative Assembly.

sections.heading: Tejashwi Yadav — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Tejashwi Yadav was born on 9 November 1988 in Patna, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Lalu Prasad Yadav and his mother, Rabri Devi. He is a sibling of Tej Pratap Yadav, Misa Bharati Devi, Raj Lakshmi Yadav and Anushka Yadav.
He received his education at Delhi Public School and Delhi Public School, Patna.

sections.heading: Tejashwi Yadav — Career and Professional Work
paras: Tejashwi Yadav works primarily as a cricketer and politician.
On the team sheet, Tejashwi has been associated with Delhi Capitals (from 2008 to 2012) and Jharkhand cricket team (from 2011 to 2012).
He has held the following offices: Member of the Bihar Legislative Assembly. He is affiliated with Rashtriya Janata Dal.
